ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
